title: fix(rest,runtime)!: the authoring-trail doors stop admitting setup.access, so an organization admin is refused the environment's trail
body:
Fixes #23546
Clause-②: yes (narrowing)

## What this does

Ruling `6187280122` (letter A), amended by the maintainer's ruling `6190477105` (Q1 → A1, Q3 → include `/diff`): four authoring-trail doors stop admitting `setup.access`, so an organization admin is refused the environment's authoring trail. The data door on the same three tables already refused that admin (`requiredPermissions: ['studio.access']`, ADR-0131 D7).

- **`packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts`.** `refuseNonAuthoringCaller` now asks a new module-private predicate, `mayReadAuthoringTrail`. It admits a system caller, `studio.access` or `manage_metadata` (`AUTHORING_TRAIL_READ_CAPABILITIES`). Its three call sites are unchanged (`GET /meta/:type/:name/history`, `/audit`, `/diff`); only their comments moved to name the new predicate.
  - `mayReadPendingDrafts` and every draft-switch call site are untouched (ruling item 4): `GET /meta/_drafts`, `?state=draft`, `?preview=draft` and the analytics `previewDrafts` still admit `setup.access`.
  - The refusal keeps its status, code and envelope (`403 FORBIDDEN`, nested `error`). Its message now names the capabilities that admit the trail.
- **`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`.** `GET /packages/:id/commits` gets its own gate, `requireCommitTrailReadCapability`: a system caller or `studio.access`. `GET /packages`, `/packages/:id` and `/export` keep `requireReadCapability` (`studio.access` or `setup.access`). `manage_metadata` alone is refused at commits, as before: no door gains a capability.
- **`packages/metadata-core/src/objects/sys-metadata-{audit,history,commit}.object.ts`.** Comment-only (ruling item 6). The comment that said these doors admit `setup.access` now names the doors' real admission. This is the cross-lane comment declared to the engine seats.
- **`content/docs/api/client-sdk.mdx`.** Two code comments said `diffItem` and `getAudit` admit `setup.access`. This change made them false, so they are corrected here (see Deviations).
- **Changeset** `.changeset/23546-trail-doors-setup-access.md`: `@objectstack/rest` and `@objectstack/runtime` `minor`, `fix(rest,runtime)!:`, the ADR-0087 marker `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`, one **BREAKING** line per door, and the objectui companion objectstack-ai/objectui#12475.

## Door × caller, before → after

Measured on a real booted stack: `@objectstack/verify` `bootStack(@objectstack/example-crm)`, `multiTenant: 'posture-only'`, `OS_TENANCY_POSTURE=isolated|group`, not degraded. Before = this branch's base `286eb9ef32`. After = `8264557efc`, the implementation commit. Each user was signed up through `/auth/organization/create` and `set-active`, with grants read by `resolveUserAuthzGrants`. The table was taken with a scratch file, which was deleted and never committed.

Walled (`isolated` and `group` answered identically):

| Door | Org admin: `setup.access`, `setup.write`, `manage_org_users`, `manage_mailboxes` | Org owner + `studio.access` | Org owner + `manage_metadata` (no `studio.access`) | Platform operator |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GET /meta/:type/:name/history` | 200 (5 events) → **403 `FORBIDDEN`** | 200 → 200 | 200 → 200 | 200 → 200 |
| `GET /meta/:type/:name/audit` | 200 (5 rows) → **403 `FORBIDDEN`** | 200 → 200 | 200 → 200 | 200 → 200 |
| `GET /meta/:type/:name/diff` | 200 → **403 `FORBIDDEN`** | 200 → 200 | 200 → 200 | 200 → 200 |
| `GET /packages/:id/commits` | 200 (2 commits) → **403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`** | 200 → 200 | 200 → **403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`** | 200 → 200 |
| `GET /meta/_drafts`, `?state=draft`, `?preview=draft`, `GET /meta/:type?preview=draft` | 200 → 200, same body | 200 → 200 | 200 → 200 | 200 → 200 |
| `GET /packages`, `/packages/:id`, `/packages/:id/export` | 200 → 200 | 200 → 200 | 200 → 200 | 200 → 200 |

`single`:

| Door | Member, no capability | `studio.access` | `manage_metadata` | `setup.access` only | Platform operator |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| history, audit, diff | 403 → 403 | 200 → 200 | 200 → 200 | admitted → **403 `FORBIDDEN`** | 200 → 200 |
| commits | 403 → 403 | 200 → 200 | 403 → 403 | admitted → **403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`** | 200 → 200 |

- The `setup.access`-only "before" cells in `single` were not in the scratch table. The ablation below reads them: putting `setup.access` back turns exactly those four pins red.
- The walled "org owner + `manage_metadata`" column is the shape W3 grants (`wall-package-doors-refusal`). It held commits through `setup.access`, and the ruling keeps commits at `system` and `studio.access`, so it loses commits.

## Tests

New and changed pins:

- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/wall-authoring-trail-doors.dogfood.test.ts` (new, project `isolated`), on the readings' rig. Under `isolated` and `group`: the org admin gets 403 at all four doors, and no part of the trail is in the body. CONTROLS: an org owner who differs from that admin by `studio.access` alone reads all four, with the operator's trail size. The draft switches answer the org admin as before (`_drafts` lists the pending draft; `?state=draft` and `?preview=draft` serve its grants). The other three package reads still answer 200. Under `single`: a `manage_metadata` holder reads history, audit and diff (CONTROL). Commits still refuses `manage_metadata` (CONTROL: no gain). A `setup.access`-only holder is refused all four (the narrowing is not a posture branch).
- `packages/rest/src/meta-history-diff-authoring-door.test.ts`: the trail builders are now `studio.access` and `manage_metadata`. A `setup.access`-only caller is refused all three doors, in the `_drafts` refusal envelope and before any protocol read, and still lists `/meta/_drafts`. The old "refuse exactly the callers `/meta/_drafts` refuses" pin becomes a strict-subset pin, caller by caller.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages-capability-gate.test.ts`: commits leaves the shared read-route loop. Its own block: 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED` (and `listCommits` never runs) for zero-capability, `setup.access`-only, the org admin's full grant, `manage_metadata`-only and `setup.access` + `manage_metadata`; 200 for `studio.access` and `isSystem`; the same `setup.access` caller still reads the other three.

Final local union at HEAD `bf1192ef1f` (the last commit), under the verify lock (slot `issue-23546`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`):

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest test`: 285 files passed; 5848 tests passed, 326 skipped.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test`: 388 files passed; 5862 tests passed, 19 skipped.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-core test`: 18 files; 728 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run --project isolated --maxWorkers=2 test/wall-authoring-trail-doors.dogfood.test.ts`: 31 passed (42 s, three boots).
- `typecheck` for rest, runtime, metadata-core and dogfood: exit 0 each. The script names echoed, so none was a zero-match filter.
- `packages/cli` is not touched, so its integration layer is not owed. Every family CI runs beyond these is CI's.

## Ablation

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, nested WRAP with restore traps (plus a shell `trap` restoring both files from `HEAD`), under the verify lock:

- Mutations: `'setup.access'` added back to `AUTHORING_TRAIL_READ_CAPABILITIES` (rest), and `&& !held.has('setup.access')` added back to the commits gate (runtime). Each one also plants the marker string `ablation-23546`. On disk, the tool read anchor 1 → 0, and blob `f534523de931` → `192df9a7b2f2` (rest) and `93319cef1c91` → `0787e7b413f8` (runtime).
- `turbo run build` for rest and runtime, then `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` (`ablation-23546` present in both `dist/`): exit 0.
- Red, exactly on the narrowing pins:
  - rest: 4 failed / 15 passed (the three `setup.access` refusals and the strict-subset pin);
  - runtime: 4 failed / 75 passed (setup-only, the org admin's full grant, setup + manage_metadata, and the cohort split);
  - dogfood: 12 failed / 19 passed (the org admin at 4 doors × 2 walls, and `setup.access` at 4 doors in `single`).
  - Every control stayed green: the studio and metadata authors, the draft switches, the other package reads, and commits refusing `manage_metadata`. The direction was red, as expected.
- Restore: both blobs equal `HEAD` and `git diff HEAD` is empty. The restore-leg rebuild ran, and `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs … --absent` exited 0 for both packages.

## Gates

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths), at `bf1192ef1f`, derived 97 commands.

- All 97 ran locally. Each exit code was captured before any pipe, and all were 0.
- `--ran` with the exit codes recorded: "97 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 97 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 97 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)."
- The first pass (at `00a11d97a3`) found one real red. `check-system-context-census` saw two new `isSystem` reads (`mayReadAuthoringTrail` and `requireCommitTrailReadCapability`) with no row on `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx`. Row 8b fixes it (`bf1192ef1f`). The same pass had two exit-3 PREREQUISITE NOT MET (`check:skill-examples` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, both unbuilt `dist/` outside this diff). Both measured exit 0 on the second pass.
- `pnpm lint` (`eslint . --no-inline-config`) at `bf1192ef1f`, under the lock: exit 0, no findings.
- The changeset gates: `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main` reads `[BREAKING+bang+clause-②-narrowing] not-required (no-migration-prescription)` ✓. `check-changeset-no-major` reads "no `major` bump" ✓ (its level axis is NOT APPLICABLE locally, because there is no `pull_request` payload; CI reads it from this PR). `check-empty-changeset` ✓.
- CI's check-runs on this PR are the record for every family outside the local list.

## Acceptance notes

- **Mechanism hypothesis (a), falsified as stated.** The meta-draft-read-door census (`meta-draft-read-door-census.test.ts`) counts only draft switches (`'draft'` comparisons, `previewDrafts`, `listDrafts`) and the bare delegation of `mayReadPendingDrafts`. This diff moves none of them, so the census stayed green, unedited. The whole-file reader the split did need is `scripts/check-system-context-census.mjs`, which wants an anchor for every `isSystem` read: row 8b.
- **Hypothesis (b), held.** objectui is not edited. The companion is objectstack-ai/objectui#12475, named in the changeset.
- **A second shape loses commits, by the ruling.** A walled organization owner granted `manage_metadata` inside its own organization (W3's shape) read commits through `setup.access`. It is refused commits now, and keeps history, audit and diff.
- **A docblock outside the file surface.** `OBJECT_SCHEMA_READ_ONLY_EXEMPT_CAPABILITIES` in `packages/metadata-core/src/object-schema-fls.ts` still calls itself "the `/packages` read cohort", which now holds for three of the four reads. The file is outside the surface, so it is left as is. Carrier: none.
- **The dogfood file's wall time.** About 42 s, for three boots (the W3 file boots three too). The 10 s per-file line is measured on Test Core shards; `measure-test-shard-timings.mjs` excludes `@objectstack/dogfood`.
- **`origin/main` moved after the last merge.** It moved five commits after `00a11d97a3`. None touches a file in this diff; CI's merge ref covers the joint state.

## Deviations

- **`content/docs/api/client-sdk.mdx`** (two code comments) is outside the claim's file surface. This change made both false: they said `setup.access` admits `diffItem` and `getAudit`. Published text that a change falsifies is corrected in the same PR (the dev role's rule), so they are corrected here.
- **`content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx`** (row 8b) is the whole-file census reader the claim allows "only as the split requires". It is named here because the claim's example named a different reader.
- **The changeset's per-door BREAKING lines are spelled "was 200 … now 403".** They carry the ordered FROM-200 / TO-403 content in the behaviour-comparison words, not a `FROM`/`TO` label.
- **`pnpm lint` was run locally because this order asks for it.** The dev role file calls repo-wide scans CI-owned; the two do not contradict each other (owed vs allowed), and the reading is above.
